comment:
For those physicians for whom date of birth was not available, ages were estimated using year of MD graduation, with age at MD graduation equal to 25 years. 
Totals include 2,762 physicians with unknown age.
Totals include 7 physicians with unknown sex.
Family medicine physicians include general practitioners, as well as family medicine specialists and emergency family medicine specialists who are certificants of the College of Family Physicians of Canada (CFPC), unless noted otherwise.

Includes active physicians who work in clinical and non-clinical practice (e.g., research and academia) who have a valid MD degree and a valid mailing address.
Includes physicians who work in non-clinical situations (such as administration or research) who may not be registered with their provincial or territorial registrar. Also, some physicians may maintain their registration status but not engage in clinical activity.
Excludes residents, semi-retired physicians, physicians in the military and non-registered physicians who have not given consent for the publication of their data.
Physician data as of December 31 of the reference year.
This data is provisional and is subject to change. Provisional data may be incomplete and counts may not match those published by other sources due to variability in data collection and reporting.
